labeller: the D6 builder agent (Claude Opus 5.5), acting as labeller; not the chart rules and not Jev
howWritten: Each question was written by hand with its result shape, then labelled from the question's intent: every chart a reader would accept for it (acceptable) and any chart that would mislead (harmful: a line or filled area across more than a handful of series, a filled area under an average or a percent, bars for more values than can be read, a scatter that throws away time order when the question asks for a trend, or bars where the question asks how two numbers move together). chartpick.mjs was not run to write any label; the self-test only checks afterwards that every label names charts the rules can draw for that shape. No answer from Jev has been seen. The labels are not yet reviewed by a person: Kane, or a person he names, reviews them before the one gate run, and a label changed then is changed before that run, never after.
note: Held out by whole model (Northstar, MSSEC, Smartsheets). Placeholder names only. Weighted toward intent words that change the best chart on the same shape: share, trend, mix, compared, best, against, relationship, exact.
